Each measured cell shows the opening's value, the code's limit and that rule's result; the opening's Result is the most cautious of every rule Gordium checked for it (see the code analysis for each). An opening the check gave no row for, or marked but not checked, is NEEDS REVIEW, never complies. Net clear sizes are with the sash fully open by
its normal operation; values never rounded toward compliance.
